title: Files, Folders, File Extensions amadi Paths
learningObjectives: Files amadi Folders-na Project ama kari oina thadokna thambiba haibadu takpa ngamgani.
File Extension khangduna madu kari sandokpaga kari sure toude haibadu takpa ngamgani.
Folder Tree paaduna Relative Path amadi Absolute Path-gi marakta leiba khennabasing khangba ngamgani.
Web Project ama thadokna thambiba ngamna achumba ming amadi Paths sijinnaba ngamgani.

understand.concept: File haibasi khongchat amasung khudam oina information thambiba yeknaba ama ni. Maduda Text, Image, Video nattraga Program Code leiba ngammi. Folder-bu Directory haina koui. Maduda Files amadi atoppa Folders thamba ngammi. Khutlai amadi subject ama mari leinaba Files ama Folder ama da thambirabadi Project adu thadokna leirammi. File nattraga Folder adu kadaida leibage haiba khangnaba sijinnaba address adubu Path koui. File Name-gi arambada leiba `.html`, `.css`, `.js`, `.png` asigumba part adubu File Extension koui. Masi masani File-gi Format nattraga madu kari oina sijinnagani haibagi signal piri. Adubu Extension khaktagi File-gi manungda kari leibage haibadu sure oina khangba ngamde.
understand.whyItMatters: Web Project ama da HTML Pages, CSS Stylesheets, JavaScript Files, Images, Fonts amadi atoppa Resources yamna leiba ngammi. Masing adu achumba Folders da thambiraga achumba Paths pirabadi Browser amadi Developer Tools-na darkar leiba Files adu thiba ngammi. Masi Code khangba, error thiba, Project manage touba amadi matungda features hangdokpa yamna phajana toubiba ngammi. Path nattraga File Name aranba oirabadi CSS apply toude, JavaScript Load toude, nattraga Image udaroi.
understand.history: Ahankpa Computer File Systems-da su information adu ming leiba Files oina thambiraga Directories nattraga Folders da thadokna thambirammi. Matungda File Name-gi arambada Extension yotuna File Type sandokpa adu yamna sijinnaba convention oirammi. Ahanba Operating Systems-na Extension yengduna File adu kari Application da hanggani haibadu khang-i. Adubu modern Systems-na File-gi manungda leiba Content su check touba ngammi. Maram aduna `.jpg` ming leiba khaktana masi actual Image File ni haibadu sure toude.
understand.analogy: School Library ama khannou. Library pumnamak Project ama gumni. Puthok adu subject matung inna khwaidagi folder nattraga shelf da thadokpa Folder ama gumni. Puthok ama File ama gumni. Puthok adu karamba shelf amadi section da leibage haiba khudam adu Path ama gumni. Puthok-gi Label-na subject-gi signal piri, adubu Label khaktagi manungda kari leibage pumnamak khangba ngamde. File Extension su madugumna signal ama ni.
understand.analogyLimit: Digital Folder asi real shelf natte; Computer da Files adu thadokna thambiba Logical Location ama ni. Path da Folder ming, File ming amadi makhoigi marakta leiba Separators asi achumba oigadabani. Separate Folders da ming ama oina Files leiba ngammi. Makhoibu khennaba khangnaba full Path darkar oi.

explain.narrative:
Project Tree asi yeng-u:

`my-site/` asi main Project Folder ni. Madugi manungda `index.html` lei. `css/` Folder gi manungda `styles.css`, `js/` da `app.js`, amadi `images/` da `logo.png` lei.

**Folder Tree kari oina paagani?** Folder ama gi makhada sedikit right side da leiba ming sing asi Folder adugi manungda leiba item sing ni. `css/`, `js/`, `images/` asi separate Folders ni. Project-gi main Folder adubu Project Root koui. Project Root dagi Logo File phaoba Path asi `images/logo.png` ni. Web example da `/` symbol-na Folder Names khennai.

**Relative Path:** Asi base location ama matung inna atoppa File adu kadaida leibage haiba sandok-i. `index.html` Project Root da leirabadi `css/styles.css` haibasi Root dagi `css` Folder da changduna `styles.css` thiba ni. HTML Page atoppa Subfolder da leirabadi Path adu change tougadabani. `../` sijinnabadi current Folder dagi level ama mathakta leiba Folder da chat-i.

**Absolute Path:** File System-gi Root nattraga fixed Root Location dagi File-gi full location sandok-i. Masi Operating System matung inna format khennai. Windows da `C:\\Users\\Student\\my-site\\index.html` oigumba Path ama leiba ngammi. Web URL da `/css/styles.css` asi Website Root dagi calculate toubiba Root-relative Path ama oigani. File System Absolute Path amadi Website Root-relative URL asi ama natte.

**HTML da Path sijinnaba:** Project Root da leiba `index.html` da `<link rel="stylesheet" href="css/styles.css">` hanna irabadi Browser-na Document-gi Base URL matung inna `css` Folder da Stylesheet thibani. HTML Page atoppa Folder da leirabadi Path change tougadabani.

**File amadi Folder ming thamba:** Spelling, Uppercase amadi Lowercase letter sing exact match oigadabani. Yamna Web Servers da `Logo.png` amadi `logo.png` asi different File Names ni. Short, clear amadi meaning leiba ming sijinnau. Space amadi strange symbols yanhande; darkar oirabadi words-gi marakta hyphen sijinnau, example `my-profile.html`.

examples.code:
my-site/
├── index.html
├── css/
│   └── styles.css
├── js/
│   └── app.js
└── images/
    └── logo.png
examples.explanation: ଇହି Tree ରେ Project Root ଏବଂ ତାହାର ଭିତରର ତିନୋଟି Resource Folders ଦେଖାଯାଇଛି। Root ରୁ Logo File ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ Path `images/logo.png`।
examples.expectedOutput: Project ର Files, Folders ଏବଂ Resource ପର୍ଯ୍ୟନ୍ତ Path ଚିହ୍ନିପାରିବେ।

examples.code:
Page: my-site/index.html
Stylesheet: my-site/css/styles.css
Relative Path: css/styles.css
HTML: <link rel="stylesheet" href="css/styles.css">
examples.explanation: `index.html` Project Root ରେ ଅଛି, ତେଣୁ Browser Base URL ଅନୁସାରେ `css` Folder ରେ Stylesheet ଖୋଜେ। Page ଅନ୍ୟ Folder ରେ ଥିଲେ Path ବଦଳିପାରେ।
examples.expectedOutput: ସଠିକ୍ Relative Path ଦ୍ୱାରା Stylesheet କୁ HTML Page ସହିତ ଯୋଡ଼ିପାରିବେ।

practise.guidedTask: Mathangdagi Project Tree sijinnaduna `index.html` dagi `js/app.js` amadi `images/logo.png` phaoba Relative Paths irou. CSS File-gi actual ming `styles.css` ni haina khannou. Adubu nahakna `css/style.css` Path pirabadi Browser-na File adu karigumba thiba ngamdribano? Folder Name amadi File Name-gi khennaba tak-u.
practise.independentTask: Profile Website ama small oina Folder Tree ama sem-u. Maduda HTML Page ama, CSS File ama, JavaScript File ama amadi Images ani leigadabani. Makhoibu suitable Folders da thambirou. Matungda `index.html` leiba Folder adu base oina File/Resource khudingmakki correct Relative Path irou.
hints: Relative Path calculate toubada HTML Page leiba Folder adu starting location oina lou. URL `/` na houjillabadi Website Root dagi calculate tou-i.
Folder Name amadi File Name khudingmakki Spelling, Uppercase/Lowercase amadi Extension check tou.
`../` haibasi current Folder dagi level ama mathakta leiba Folder da chatpa ni.
File Extension asi general signal ama ni; File-gi manungda kari leibage haibadu sure toude.

questions.prompt: `my-site/index.html` dagi `my-site/css/styles.css` File phaoba chatnaba correct Relative Path karino?
questions.explanation: `index.html` Project Root da lei amadi `css` Folder su same Root da lei. Maram aduna `css/` Folder da changduna manungda leiba `styles.css` thigadabani.

options: File-gi manungda kari leibage haibadu matam pumnamakta sure oina tak-i.
File-gi Format nattraga madu kari oina sijinnagani haibagi general signal piri.
File adu karamba Folder da leibage haibadu sandok-i.
questions.answer: File-gi Format nattraga madu kari oina sijinnagani haibagi general signal piri.
questions.explanation: Extension asi general Naming Convention ama ni. File ming-na aranba signal piba ngammi amadi System-na manunggi Content su check touba ngammi.
